name: state_machines_idle
description: STATE-MACHINE LEAKS (E2E_PLAN g3): do an interaction, END it, then assert every state machine noticed. A scroll starts the scroll manager (offset moves, scroll_dirty is set); a CSS override then forces the relayout that rebuilds the display list and clears scroll_dirty; tick_ms drives the (zero-duration) scroll animation to completion. assert_state_machines_idle then sweeps: no active drag, no un-ended gesture session, no active scroll animation, scroll_dirty cleared, scrollbar_fade_active cleared, no latched text_edit display_list_dirty, no orphan caret blink, no unresolved focus request, and FrameDamage::None on the last frame. FAILURE INJECTION EVIDENCE: dropping the `clear_scroll_dirty()` call at window.rs (end of layout_and_generate_display_list) makes this fixture go red with 'scroll_manager.scroll_dirty is still set'.
